open_findings.title: Finish reconciling the active DESKTOP-SHELL contract resolution
open_findings.finding: The focused plan revision 20 marks exact-set review/approval complete and authorizes bounded probes/bootstrap, but its registered DESKTOP-SHELL.resolution still says implementation remains held until reconciliation, fresh reviews and explicit exact-set approval. This is the contract portion of prior finding EAPR-01 and remains unchanged in the current CLI binding.
open_findings.impact: The active decision register contradicts the completed approval state and can cause a downstream owner to re-request an already-given approval or hold authorized bounded work.
open_findings.required_correction: Update the resolution to record that packet r1 and its receipt complete the exact-set approval and that the bounded synthetic-data Electron/OpenCode probes/bootstrap are authorized, subject to current independent review/handoff registration and the existing exclusions. Re-register/review the changed contract; retain packet, receipt and document bytes/hashes unchanged and do not ask for another user approval.

observations: Approval packet r1 SHA-256 9d45be0146846ed0cf3e4bf91995b7dff3e858fc355794bdae2af272ef401ecd and receipt SHA-256 deb1ebf40030d5855821af2f3a6a3bb0a8e94304b04492e0f0217921a1a7b885 match current bytes and the focused contract. The receipt explicitly authorizes bounded Electron/OpenCode probes and bootstrap; no repeated user approval is needed.

All nine focused document paths, versions and hashes match current bytes, the immutable packet table and parent registrations. The parent has two additional registered documents outside this nine-file approval. Electron main ownership, typed renderer admission, preview isolation and both macOS/Windows targets remain preserved.

Persistent personal data/storage/retention, user/global configuration and credentials, ambient services, public release, signing/notarization, app stores, auto-update and external telemetry remain held or excluded. Windows behavior still requires Windows execution; no package compatibility or runtime evidence is certified here.

All explicit active focused-plan revision references in the parent plan and contract now say revision 20. Packet r1 remains an immutable pre-approval snapshot at focused revision 18/parent revision 15; historical reports and change-history entries retain older revisions.

The broader claim that every reference outside history says revision 20 is not literally true: approved frozen UX line 5 and verification line 5 retain revision 18, and UX retains pre-review wording. Those exact approved document bytes must not be silently rewritten. Current execution authority is the focused plan revision 20 plus approval receipt; preserve the snapshot digests and distinguish their pre-approval labels from current gate status.

Independent product-review-r5 and design-spec-review-r5 reports pass for the unchanged nine document hashes, but bind focused plan revision 18. Both current ledgers have empty active reviews after plan re-registration. Read-only CLI handoff attempts for product/design_spec on both runs fail with: Obtain and record an independent pass for the current plan and contract first. After resolving the focused finding and recording current plan passes, the coordinator must obtain/register valid current downstream bindings and pass matching handoffs before dispatch. Historical semantic passes alone do not establish current CLI handoff readiness.
validation: Independent static linked-plan review using exact CLI review-input bindings. Verified file digests, contract registrations, approval scope, current ledger status, existing independent review reports and read-only document handoff results. No tests, installs, Electron/OpenCode processes or runtime probes were executed. Only the two assigned reports were written.
